description: Presidential Secretariat - Removed State Ministers from their State Ministerial Portfolios with effect from September 05, 2024.
reasoning: This gazette exclusively lists the removal of named individuals (Hon. Agampodi Mohan Priyadarshana de Silva, etc.) from their State Ministerial Portfolios.
